cases.name: first-small-root-program
cases.assert: Compare complete structured diagnostics and actual program files with the public TS6 compiler under identical options. Resolve adapter defects before wider proof. This is one project, not canonical coverage.

cases.name: real-maintained-negative
cases.assert: First confirm a current real native diagnostic at this maintained source. Identical native diagnostic must govern through both recipes, irrespective of code/category/message. Preserve all other diagnostics and raw counts. If this source is now clean, record that change and use another actual maintained diagnostic, not a fabricated receipt.

cases.name: global-negative
cases.deferredTree: spikes/a2a-pi/ is DEFERRED BY OWNER (#216 comment 6830616474) and not in ts_projects. It stays the public native fixture for this adapter contract: the direct --compiler-project child is project-agnostic, and no gated project has a no-file/global diagnostic to replace it. A direct adapter case, never a gate result for the deferred tree.
cases.nativeObservation: TS2688 missing vite/client in actual prior enumeration
cases.assert: Reproduce under the current installed inputs. Global/options/config/no-file diagnostics always govern, including the complete native TS2688 record. No frozen-file exception may suppress a native global/config/options diagnostic.

cases.name: frozen-byte-before-analysis
cases.assert: Use a disposable copy with the existing literal inventory and existing SHA256SUMS. Append a real byte mutation. Integrity must fail before TypeScript program construction. Never execute/import the capture.

cases.name: unknown-file-default-maintained
cases.assert: Create a disposable unclassified tracked/untracked TS input outside the actual include sets. Its literal path must appear in the adapter's coverage-gap failure. No invented project/default-project admission. Remove only the owned temporary input afterward.

cases.name: native-frozen-bundle
cases.assert: Compare the full native diagnostic multiset with governing plus integrityOnly records. Only exact verified integrity-only source paths partition out of source semantic enforcement. Related information, native codes/categories/spans and message chains remain intact. nativeDiagnosticFree must stay false when any raw diagnostic exists, even if all belong to verified data.

cases.name: real-program-union
cases.assert: After narrow cases pass, compare the two canonical recipes' actual program files/options/project list. All maintained literal inputs must occur in the union, or fail closed with the complete missing list. Preserve any global/config failures; enumeration is not a coverage PASS while those remain. No broad lint or package installation is part of this proof.
